'''2007 US East Nationals Day 2 Tim Simon LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Please Don't Play ROPS
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
